notes: No case suffix (ର, ରେ, କୁ, ଙ୍କ) is attached directly to a name placeholder; a colon or a following noun carries it. Separate postposition words (ପରେ, ପାଇଁ, ପୂର୍ବେ) and the spaced locative ରେ after time/number placeholders are used where natural.
Odia verbs and pronouns carry no gender, so nothing agrees with the player or a {name}.
Generated names use the default setting (first part, space, second part): Odia puts the modifier before the noun (ବଜ୍ର + ଶୃଙ୍ଗ = ବଜ୍ର ଶୃଙ୍ଗ). First parts are invariant modifiers, second parts nouns.
Intl formats numbers for or in Latin digits, so digits inside text are Latin as well.
Sentences end with the danda (।); text.period is ।.
Japanese statutory pages (tokushoho, shikin-kessai) are translated into Odia with the English glosses dropped, as in the Bengali worksheet; the support page links them by their Japanese titles.
pages.tokushoho.1 is long relative to the Japanese source because the Odia title spells out the law name.
